 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY
ORAL ORDER 2 13-02-2024 Heard the parties.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred for the following relief:
"(i)For issuance of an order/orders, direction/directions or writ/writs particularly in the nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned acquisition notification issued vide memo no.1754, and 1833 and 1820 dated 08.01.2014 and issued by Special Land Acquisition Officer, Gandak Project, District- Muzaffarpur, whereby and whereunder the State Government has acquired the lands of the petitioners measuring an area contained in the impugned memos for constructing an Patna High Court CWJC No.9112 of 2016(2) dt.13-02-2024 embankment over the Bagmati river in the emergent situation, as the entire proceeding in respect of the petitioner's land stood lapsed in view of coming into force of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Anil Kumar Verma And Ors vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32821142/
1 (ii) For issuance of an order/orders, direction/directions or writ/writs particularly in the nature of writ of Mandamus commanding upon the respondents authorities to pay the compensation amount to the petitioners according to the statutory provisions in view of coming into Force of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for the acquisition of the land of the petitioners.

sentences.text: (iii) Any other relief or reliefs to which the petitioners may be found entitled to in the facts and circumstances of the case.

3. A counter-affidavit on behalf of respondent No. 04, The Special Land Acquisition Officer,
Muzaffarpur is on record.

The paragraphs 4 an 5 read as follows:
"4. That the deponent humbly submits that in this connection, notices were issued to the petitioners for submission of revenue Patna High Court CWJC No.9112 of 2016(2) dt.13-02-2024 documents of concerned lands, such as L.P.C., Current rent receipt, Khatiyan, Kewala etc. to receive payment of compensation.
5. That all three persons named above, have received notice, to submit revenue documents but till yet none of them appeared in the office with revenue documents to receive payment of acquired land.

The deponent humbly submits that whenever the petitioner file their required documents,
compensation amount of land will be paid to them."
4.
The counter affidavit is of the year 2016 and 8 years later there is no rejoinder on record.
5. At this stage, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that as a last chance two weeks time be granted so that he can submit the present situation of the case.
6. As a last chance, the matter is adjourned for two weeks.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
